messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT 1959999999 — embed-service.p99_latency > 2.5s for 4m in prod-eu. Automated paging to #eng-oncall and @Julia M.
Julia M: Oncall Julia here. Observing sustained p99 latency, a bunch of connecting timeouts from workers. Pulling traces.
Raj P: I'm seeing queue-depth spike on dedicated-embed-pool-3. Autoscaler didn't add nodes in last 10m.
Leo C: Hmm autoscaler logs show failed scale-up due to quota error: 
```
ERROR: insufficient-cores: request 12 > quota 8 for project-prod-eu
```

InfraBot: NOTE — quota event detected for project-prod-eu, marked as blocking.
Julia M: That would explain latency. Can we emergency increase pool or shift traffic?
Raj P: I can shift 20% traffic from pool-3 to pool-1 which has spare capacity. Initiating gradual shift.
PagerDuty: Paging suppressed for low-severity infra alerts per recent throttling policy.
Leo C: After shifting, p99 dropped to 1.1s on pool-1 but overall p99 still 1.9s.
Julia M: Good progress. Let's keep pages to a minimum while we stabilize; enable temporary alert mute for non-customer-facing infra alerts.
Eve Q: Support flagged two customers experiencing failures on batch-embed endpoint. We need to track customer impact for postmortem.
Julia M: Action: create incident ticket and mark affected customers. I'll also start a short-lived incident bridge.
IncidentBot: Bridge created: https://zoom/incident-1959999999 (ops mode: partial).
Raj P: Scale-up succeeded after quota adjustment by infra team. Pool-3 added 4 nodes; queue depth returning to normal.
Leo C: Root cause looks like a quota configuration drift between EU and US projects after a terraform change last week.
Eve Q: For routing/alerts: current config pages on p99 > 1.5s for 3m. That created noisy pages during transient infra activities. Recommend we change to: page for p99 >= 2.5s for 3m OR p99 >= 1.5s AND customer_impact == true. Otherwise open ticket to eng-sre channel.
Julia M: +1 to Eve. Also propose adding a dedup rule: if same latency alert fires > 6x in 15m escalate to P1.
Raj P: Also suggest adding a synthetic canary check by region to avoid global pages when only one pool is affected. Canaries should trigger tickets but not pages.
Leo C: I'll draft the alert rule patch. Proposed snippet: 
```
- name: embed-service.p99_latency
  conditions:
    - when: "p99_ms >= 2500 and duration >= 3m"
      severity: P1
      routes: ["pagerduty-prod"]
    - when: "p99_ms >= 1500 and duration >= 3m and customer_impact == true"
      severity: P1
      routes: ["pagerduty-prod"]
    - when: "p99_ms >= 1500 and duration >= 3m"
      severity: P2
      routes: ["eng-sre"]
  dedupe:
    threshold: 6
    window_min: 15
```

InfraBot: Suggested action: create dashboard panel correlating pool queue_depth, scale events, quota errors, and p99.
Eve Q: I'll own dashboard PR and include example queries + alert tests. We should also add runbook steps: shift traffic, request quota bump, and rollback.
Julia M: Assigning follow-ups:
- Julia: incident ticket + postmortem skeleton and customer impact blurb (due EOD).
- Leo: PR for alert rule changes and dedupe config (link in ticket).
- Raj: infra ticket to reconcile terraform drift and verify quotas in staging.
- Eve: dashboard + runbook updates.
PagerDuty: Updated mapping queued: new rules will map P1 to on-call pager only when severity=P1 criteria met.
Julia M: We'll hold a 40m post-incident sync to confirm RCA and action items. If anything regresses we'll reopen the bridge.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT 1959999999 1 STATUS: mitigated. Primary mitigation: traffic shift + quota adjustment + scale-up.
Raj P: Opening infra ticket INFRA-4042 to reconcile quota drift and add a CI check to prevent terraform from reducing project quotas without review.
Leo C: I'll include a small dashboard panel in the PR showing before/after p99 for pool-3.
Eve Q: Note for postmortem: alert fatigue risk was real here; we were paged automatically due to a conservative p99 threshold. The new routing config should reduce noise but keep fast detection when customers are actually affected.
Julia M: Thanks team. Handoff to Raj for infra follow-up. I'm standing down from active pager. :white_check_mark:
